rules.description: ID, body, date, and source are required.
Event type must be job_gain, job_loss, no_event, or ambiguous.
When present, job count must be a non-negative integer.
Gain/loss assertions require a non-empty evidence span.
Gain/loss confidence must meet the run threshold.
The assertion must link to a generating activity and source entity.
The assertion must link to the ordered trajectory and contract.
